::: {#exm-subset-transitive}
#### A chain of subsets

@sol-between-roots shows that
$\set{x \in \reals : x^2 - 3x + 2 < 0} \subseteq \set{x \in \reals : 0 < x < 3}$,
and every real number between 0 and 3 is positive, so
$\set{x \in \reals : 0 < x < 3} \subseteq \set{x \in \reals : x > 0}$.
By @thm-subset-transitive,
$\set{x \in \reals : x^2 - 3x + 2 < 0} \subseteq \set{x \in \reals : x > 0}$.

:::
